items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Variants default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link; sizes sm, default, lg and three square icon sizes. Supports asChild and a loading state.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Animated status indicator for work in progress, announced as Loading.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short status or metadata label. Solid, secondary and outline styles, plus success, warning and destructive statuses shown as a coloured dot.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible name for a form control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text control. Its error state comes from aria-invalid, so any form library can drive it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text control with the same states as Input.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with icons, text or buttons attached on either side.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Layout for a control with its label, description and error, plus fieldset and group helpers. Independent of any form library.

items.name: form
items.title: Form Field (react-hook-form)
items.description: FormField: a react-hook-form Controller laid out with Field, with the id, label and ARIA wiring done for you.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one can be selected.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off control for settings that apply immediately.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one option from a list, with groups, labels and separators.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Container with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout for important messages on a neutral surface; default, success, warning and destructive tones colour the icon.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.
